one_row_is: one row is one record, identified by its `location_id` value
holds: Every place in the building: site, buildings, levels, level-blocks and rooms.

one_row_is: one row is one record, identified by its `panel` value
holds: Every distribution board on the load schedule, with its rating and where it is fed from.
declared_joins: bld_locations — `bld_panels.location_id` = `bld_locations.location_id` — the level-block the board is in

one_row_is: one row is one record, identified by its `door_id` value
holds: One row per access-controlled door position drawn on the as-built drawings, with the room it is printed in.
declared_joins: bld_locations — `bld_om_a_doors.location_id` = `bld_locations.location_id` — the room the door is printed in

one_row_is: one row is one record, identified by its `equipment_id` value
holds: The owner's own maintained register: one row per unit, with the place it is installed at.
declared_joins: bld_locations — `bld_equipment.location_id` = `bld_locations.location_id` — the room, level-block, level or site the unit is installed at

one_row_is: one row is one record, identified by its `count_id` value
holds: Per-room device quantity rows, three systems.
declared_joins: bld_locations — `bld_equipment_counts.location_id` = `bld_locations.location_id` — the room the counted devices are in

one_row_is: one row is one record, identified by its `circuit_zone` value
holds: Every circuit on the load schedule, resolved back to the board that feeds it.

one_row_is: one row is one record, identified by its `rel_id` value
holds: Evidence-backed links between a circuit, a system or a piece of equipment and the place or system it acts on.
declared_joins: bld_circuits — `bld_relationships.subject_id` = `bld_circuits.db + '/' + cir_no` — when subject_type = circuit: the circuit that feeds the printed load
bld_locations — `bld_relationships.object_id` = `bld_locations.location_id` — when object_type = location: the place a relationship points at
